saints.name: St. Clare
saints.title: Virgin
saints.shortBlurb: The first follower of St. Francis among women, who founded the Poor Clares and loved “holy poverty” to the end…
biography: A noblewoman of Assisi, Clare heard Francis preach and fled her family by night to receive the habit from his hands, beginning the community of Poor Ladies (the Poor Clares) at San Damiano. She defended their “privilege of poverty” against those who would soften it, and once, it is said, put an enemy army to flight by holding up the Blessed Sacrament.
She was the first woman to write a religious rule for women. She died at San Damiano in 1253.
saints.knownFor: Founding the Poor Clares in radical Franciscan poverty.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 12 August
